verdict.rationale: Cal.com's API v2 documents a full webhook subsystem with subscribable triggers (BOOKING_CREATED, BOOKING_PAYMENT_INITIATED, BOOKING_PAID, BOOKING_RESCHEDULED, BOOKING_REQUESTED, BOOKING_CANCELLED) via a create-webhook endpoint, directly enabling event-driven/agentic subscription patterns. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of webhook delivery reliability and no explicit mention of AI-agent-specific webhook consumption patterns beyond generic API docs.
